title: Manual development links and stage assignment rules
summary: Current integration features are manually maintained development URLs and stage-entry assignee rules. Automatic Git provider synchronization, build webhooks and a general trigger/action automation builder are outside the implemented boundary.

cases.title: Read manual development links
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open the issue's Development section.
expected: Visible manually entered links show kind, title and destination hostname.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-INT-0061.

cases.title: Read empty development links
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open Development for an issue without links.
expected: The empty state appears without implying provider synchronization.

cases.title: Page development links
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Choose Load more development links.
expected: The next cursor page appends.
notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-INT-0059.

cases.title: Add a pull_request development link
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Save a valid pull_request URL and title.
expected: The manually maintained typed link appears on the issue.

cases.title: Add a commit development link
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Save a valid commit URL and title.

cases.title: Add a other development link
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.

cases.title: Follow a development link

cases.title: Edit development link title

cases.title: Edit development link URL
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Save a changed URL for a retained link.

cases.title: Edit development link kind

cases.title: Detach a development link

steps: Choose Remove for an existing development link.

cases.title: Cancel development link editing
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Cancel an open link form.

cases.title: Retain Arabic development link titles

notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-INT-0063.

cases.title: Page assignment rules

cases.title: Read empty automation rules

steps: Open Automation where no assignment rules exist.
expected: The empty state explains stage-entry assignment.

cases.title: Create an enabled assignment rule
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.

cases.title: Create a disabled assignment rule

cases.title: Rename an assignment rule

cases.title: Change an assignment rule's assignee
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Choose another eligible teammate and save.
expected: Later matching stage entries assign the new teammate.

cases.title: Disable an assignment rule

cases.title: Enable an assignment rule
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.

cases.title: Cancel assignment rule editing

cases.title: Search rule assignees as typed

cases.title: Page rule assignee choices

cases.title: Run assignment rule on stage entry
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Move an issue into a stage with an enabled eligible rule.
expected: Assignment joins the same move transaction and existing completion/permission guards remain authoritative.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

steps: Move work after its configured assignee loses project eligibility.
expected: The rule does not assign work to the revoked teammate.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Keep a retired-stage rule inert
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Exercise work after its configured stage is retired.
expected: The obsolete stage rule does not assign work.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

notes: Surface correction preserves this complete browser behavior; stateless service outcomes are recorded separately in UC-INT-0065.

cases.title: Reject rule writes by ordinary members
preconditions: Actor is a project member without administration authority.
steps: Submit a rule mutation without project administrator authority.
expected: The server refuses configuration writes.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Reject blank development link title

cases.title: Reject credential-bearing development URLs

cases.title: Reject malformed development URLs

cases.title: Reject oversized development URLs
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Submit more than 2000 URL characters.
expected: The link is refused.

cases.title: Reject unsupported development link kind
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.

cases.title: Reject an already-removed new link
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Create a new link ID with removed true.
expected: A new link must initially be visible.

cases.title: Reject development writes on archived issue
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Save a link for an archived issue.
expected: The issue must be restored before link mutation.

cases.title: Reject blank automation rule name
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a whitespace-only rule name.

cases.title: Reject oversized automation rule name

cases.title: Reject a second enabled rule for a stage
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable another rule for a stage that already has an enabled rule.
expected: The uniqueness guard prevents competing enabled stage assignments.

cases.title: Reject an ineligible rule assignee
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Enable a rule targeting a user without active project eligibility.

cases.title: Reject an unavailable rule stage

steps: Enable a rule for a noncurrent stage.

cases.title: Reject mismatched rule stage identity
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Submit inconsistent native stage ID and stage token.
expected: Validation requires one matching stage identity.

cases.title: Reject a stale development link revision
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Save a link after another actor changed it.
expected: The newer link is preserved through a typed conflict.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Reject a stale assignment rule revision
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save a rule after another administrator changed it.
expected: The stale operation cannot overwrite the newer rule.
notes: Source classification correction: the native action and its validation/recovery path are present. This records implementation availability, not a passing runtime coverage claim.

cases.title: Replay an accepted development link write
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Retry the same accepted link operation after losing the response.
expected: The stable link ID and retry reference prevent duplicate side effects.

cases.title: Replay an accepted assignment rule write
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Retry an accepted rule operation after losing the response.
expected: The stable rule ID and retry reference confirm the original mutation once.

cases.title: Ignore stale assignee-search replies
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Change the query or project while a rule-assignee search is pending.
expected: Generation/session ownership discards obsolete search results.

cases.title: Reflow development links on narrow screens
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open a long-title development link list on a narrow viewport.
expected: Content wraps and link actions reflow without hiding the destination.

cases.title: Reflow assignment rules on narrow screens
preconditions: Signed in with project read access.
steps: Open Automation on a narrow viewport.
expected: Rule rows and editor reflow to a usable single-column layout.

cases.title: Retain Arabic assignment rule names
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Save an Arabic rule name.
expected: The exact Unicode name remains readable.

cases.title: Discover automation stages beyond the first board directory page
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Create 26 alphabetically earlier nondefault boards, then open automation stage choices.
expected: All four eligible default-workflow stages remain selectable even when All Issues is beyond the first board-directory page.
notes: The browser regression passed after discovery moved to typed paginated workflow/stage reads, independent of board-directory pagination.

cases.title: Isolate development-link continuations
preconditions: Signed in with write access to the issue's active project.
steps: Switch issue or sign out and back in while a development-link read or accepted save reply is delayed.
expected: An obsolete read error, saving state or save continuation cannot affect the destination issue editor or the new signed-in session.
notes: The actual late read failure already remained isolated through native detail child recreation. Additional delayed-save/session checks retain that behavior as an explicit regression boundary.
Implementation status is separate from the first-attempt runtime evidence ledger.

cases.title: Isolate late automation saves
preconditions: Signed in as a project administrator in an active project.
steps: Accept a rule save but delay its reply, then open a different project rule editor.
expected: The source rule remains in its original project; the late reply cannot close, overwrite or reload the destination project editor.
notes: Reproduced destination-editor closure; rule saves now check project, session, editor-generation and component ownership.
Implementation status is separate from the first-attempt runtime evidence ledger.

cases.title: Configure assignment for an eligible stage absent from the default board
preconditions: An active workflow stage is valid for assignment automation but intentionally not mapped in the default board layout.
steps: Page workflow and stage choices, select an open unmapped stage, and save an enabled assignment rule.
expected: The eligible unmapped stage is selectable across real workflow/stage cursor pages; a closed stage is excluded, and saving retains the exact selected stage ID.
notes: The browser regression passed with an active future workflow absent from default-board mappings and real limit-one workflow/stage pages.

expected: The next distinct assignable user IDs are returned without overlapping the first page.

cases.title: Enforce viewer development-link service access
preconditions: Actor has viewer access to the issue's project.
steps: Read development links as a viewer and attempt a link mutation.
expected: The authorized link read succeeds while current write permission refuses the mutation.
notes: Atomic service outcome separated from native UI case UC-INT-0030.
